subject: Proposal: Service Relief & Trial Top-Up for Sentinel Platform Latency Spike
messages:
From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@sentinelhealth.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Latency spike — Redwood endpoints returning 500s during morning batch

Hi Monica,

We started seeing a sharp latency spike and intermittent 500s across our inference calls to the /v1/generate endpoints this morning between ~08:45–09:05 PDT. It affected a handful of mission-critical jobs that run on a 15-minute cadence; a few ran into timeouts and were retried, causing duplicate downstream events.

Impact summary:
- 6 failed jobs, ~3,000 user-facing tokens delayed
- Increased error rate caused duplicate billing events in our pipeline
- On-call team had to intervene for manual retries/cleanup

Attaching raw logs and a short timeline (raw-logs.zip). We need to understand whether this maps to a capacity issue or a regression on the model-serving side. Can you confirm whether this incident is covered under the SLA and what remediation you can offer?

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Cho
Head of Platform Reliability, Sentinel Health
emily.cho@sentinelhealth.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-15T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Latency spike — Redwood endpoints returning 500s during morning batch

Emily — thanks for the quick heads-up and for sending the logs. I'm sorry for the disruption this morning. We're already triaging from our side. Immediate notes:

- I've opened an internal incident and asked infra to pull metrics for the timeframe you reported.
- We'll correlate request traces to the logs you attached and confirm whether this is an autoscaling/throttling anomaly or a runtime regression.

Proposed remediation (initial):
- Priority 1: Root-cause analysis and timelines (I will share an incident summary by EOD).
- Priority 2: If this qualifies under the SLA, we will propose a one-time service credit and a trial/top-up to make up for lost processing during the affected window.

Can you confirm approximate monthly spend so we can calculate a fair credit percentage? Also, is Sentinel open to a short trial extension (30–45 days) as a goodwill gesture while we complete RCA and fixes?

I'll loop Rishi and Sean to get approval on the proposed credit approach and communications.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
(attachment: incident_summary_draft.pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Latency spike — Redwood endpoints returning 500s during morning batch

Thanks Monica — quick internal take:

- If the RCA shows it was on our routing/autoscaling configuration we should offer a formal credit aligned to SLA language. For an incident of this magnitude (short outage but customer impact), a 15–25% single-invoice credit is typical, paired with a trial/top-up to keep their integration work moving (helps retention).
- Suggestion: calculate credit against their last invoice (30-day window). If their typical monthly spend is >$50k, cap credit at $15k; for <$50k we can do up to 25% of monthly spend.

I can sign off on the numbers for deals under $10k; for larger credits we'll need sales leader approval.

Also drafting a short customer note to avoid legal review overhead — will share language in the thread.

Rishi
VP, Sales — Enterprise

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-15T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Latency spike — Redwood endpoints returning 500s during morning batch

+1 on Rishi's approach. For speed, let's push a provisional offer to the customer (subject to RCA) and note we'll finalize amount after the postmortem. Laura, can you help with the billing side to reserve the credit and confirm the cap?

Also Monica — please include a clear timeline in the customer note: when they should expect credit to be applied and what temporary mitigations we've put in place. We don't need legal for the initial customer-facing message unless they ask for contract language.

Thanks — Sean
Director, Customer Success

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-16T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Formal offer: Relief package following today’s latency incident

Hi Emily — following our investigation and internal reviews, thank you again for the logs — they helped us confirm that the spike coincided with a temporary autoscaling misconfiguration in a routing tier. We sincerely apologize for the disruption.

Our proposed relief package (provisional, subject to final RCA summary):
- One-time service credit equal to 20% of Sentinel Health's most recent monthly invoice (estimated credit: $12,000).
- 45-day trial/top-up of platform credits to help catch up any backlog and validate fixes.
- Dedicated postmortem and a 72-hour follow-up plan from our infra team; we'll share a final RCA and remediation steps by 2027-08-18 EOD.

Logistics:
- Credits will be reserved against your account immediately and applied within 3 business days after you confirm acceptance.
- We'll follow up with a DocuSign acknowledgement for auditability (link below) and a short billing lookup that shows the calculation.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/share/ABCD-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8471
(attachments: approved-communications.docx, credits-invoice-lookup.csv)

If that package looks reasonable to Sentinel leadership, reply here and we'll process the credit and extend the trial right away.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Monica — thank you for the quick turnaround and for the transparent breakdown. The package looks fair. We accept the proposed 20% credit and 45-day trial extension. Please apply the credit and send confirmation when complete; also loop me on the RCA when available.

We'll sign the acknowledgement via the DocuSign link. Appreciate the swift support — this keeps our rollout timeline on track.

Best,
Emily
